source_assessments.observation: Describes XBRL as-filed financial-statement data and warns about extraction errors and missing metadata. Metadata is not the actual quarterly data archive.
Security master covers historical corporate actions and identities, but the provider explicitly states it is not the underlying equity-price dataset; that requires a separate AlgoSeek license.

Advertises broader active/delisted PIT-ready coverage and a free entry-level dataset for current Dow30 companies. A free sample or product description does not establish a complete historical universe or current user authorization.

The actual page demonstrates cryptocurrency dataset/backtest tooling. Search-generated claims of complete US-stock security-master and delisting coverage were not verified and are not admitted as evidence.
